plugins.name: article-maker
plugins.description: Turn any source (URL, PDF, DOCX, Markdown, plain text, screenshots, pasted notes) into a beautiful, share-ready single-file HTML article that opens offline, with optional companion PDF (bundles the article-maker skill).

plugins.name: harness-zh
plugins.description: DEPRECATED, merged into super-harness 0.2.0. Frozen at 0.2.2 (refuses to run in a super-harness project); migrate with /plugin install super-harness@my-cc-plugin, /super-harness:init, /plugin uninstall harness-zh.

plugins.name: super-harness
plugins.description: BMad-based sprint orchestration (harness-zh merged in): run stories one at a time in-session (/super-harness:run-inline) or in parallel with one worktree + headless claude worker per story and a serial merge queue (/super-harness:run). Requires BMad >= 6.11 + uv.

plugins.name: ppt-maker
plugins.description: Web deck + genuinely editable .pptx from one deck.json source of truth, dual-rendered off a shared geometry engine with mechanical EMU verification. 18 charts, 23 layouts incl. 8 analysis frameworks, 24 validated theme palettes, in-browser console with one-click .pptx export, PDF export.

plugins.name: video-maker
plugins.description: Turn scripts and articles into click-driven 16:9 web presentations you can screen-record as cinematic videos (bundles the web-video-presentation skill).
